verdicts.quote: All-or-nothing: if any row or the file is invalid, no user is created.
a rejected row-level outcome carries error_count (the true total), truncated, and errors (at most 100, ordered by row ...), each with row, line, field when it applies, code
two rows of the same file whose emails are equal after normalisation → the later row is duplicate_in_file ... A row whose normalised email equals an existing user's → email_taken.
an attribute the admin expects to be applied (role) ... any other column is an error. / assigns no role beyond whatever the product gives a new user by default
the import operation and the import page are available to an authenticated administrator and to no one else. / "Admin" means whatever the product already treats as an administrator
verdicts.missing: Whether a non-admin who can create a single user may import; the spec never says the import ability is distinct from single-user-create permission.

verdicts.quote: header: missing_column (email or name absent), unknown_column, duplicate_column: all header problems are reported together
an optional BOM is accepted and removed; CRLF and LF line endings are both accepted; a quoted field may contain commas, doubled quotes and line breaks as in RFC 4180.
inside one transaction ... If any insert fails, the transaction is rolled back, no user remains / The import sets no credential and sends no message
two configured limits apply: MAX_BYTES (file size) and MAX_ROWS ... Over either → rejected, nothing created. ... No default number is specified.
verdicts.missing: The actual maximum file size and row count values (left to OG-2).

verdicts.quote: empty → [empty_file]; header-only → [no_rows] / one row is a valid file
a repeat of the same upload is safe (it succeeds if nothing was created, or is rejected row by row if it was).
all within the request that carried the file. The caller receives the final outcome in the response. No job queue, no status polling, no background worker.
The import itself sets no password or other credential, assigns no role ... and sends no email or other message.
an imported user is created through the same creation rules as the product's single-user creation ... sets no password ... how they sign in is not decided here (OG-4).
verdicts.missing: Whether the user is active or pending and how they first sign in.

verdicts.quote: the uploaded bytes live only in the memory of the request that carried them and are discarded when it ends; they are not written to disk ... no other client can fetch the result.
every import attempt by an authenticated user writes one audit record: actor id, time, outcome ... row_count ... created_count, error_count and byte_size.

verdicts.where: Section 6 forbidden events, Section 1 out of scope
verdicts.quote: cancellation, expiry and restart are n/a: the operation is one synchronous request with no retained work / importing only the valid rows of a file with errors
No latency or size number is specified: unresolved (OG-2) / pending (the control keeps focus and announces "Importing…"
verdicts.missing: A numeric time bound for a maximum-size file and any progress indication beyond a pending label.

verdicts.quote: Existing users are neither changed nor skipped. / this feature never changes or removes a user
verdicts.missing: That the existing single-user create flow continues to work unchanged is not stated.

verdicts.quote: Neutralising values that begin with =, +, - or @ when a later feature exports users to CSV is that feature's duty / name 1–100 characters / The body never contains the contents of a cell.
